_comment: App routes that may still be named inside the built viewer.
None of them can be reached: the viewer has no server, and netGuard.ts
refuses every /api/ call locally except the 'answered locally' ones.
A route appears here only with the reason its leftover mention is inert.
Anything not listed fails the build (check-dist.mjs).

why./api/wikipedia/summary: Answered locally: the visitor's browser asks Wikipedia directly.
why./api/rest_v1/page/summary: Part of the Wikipedia address above, not an app route.
why./api/ai/analysis-zones: Delete button exists only on analysis zones, which the public engine never has. Refused.
why./api/ai/news/summary: AI brief; its button is hidden by a cut. Refused.
why./api/ai/pins: Pin saving; pin placement mode is never switched on in the viewer. Refused.
why./api/ai/pins/geojson: Runs only when the AI pins layer is on; that layer is hidden. Refused.
why./api/geocode/search: Place-name search; the viewer takes coordinates only. Refused.
why./api/oracle/region-intel: Automatic read on some popups. Refused; the popup shows no extra intel.
why./api/osm-tile: OSM basemap; that basemap choice is removed by a cut.
why./api/radio/openmhz/audio: Scanner tracker; the scanner layer is hidden so nothing can be tracked.
why./api/route: Automatic flight-route read on select. Refused; no route line is drawn.
why./api/sar/aois: Runs only when the SAR layer is on; that layer is hidden. Refused.
why./api/sigint/meshtastic/scan: Scan button removed by a cut; this is its unreachable handler.
why./api/trail/flight: Automatic trail read on select. Refused; trails come from published data only.
why./api/viewport: Map-pan notice to the server. Refused.
